findings.title: Skill does not specify a license
findings.description: Skill manifest does not include a 'license' field. Specifying a license helps users understand usage terms.
findings.remediation: Add 'license' field to SKILL.md frontmatter (e.g., MIT, Apache-2.0)

findings.title: Unpinned dependency
findings.description: Dependency 'requests' has no pinned (==) version. Unpinned dependencies in a skill package allow a later, potentially malicious release to be installed automatically (supply-chain risk).
findings.remediation: Pin the dependency to an exact version (e.g. 'package==1.2.3').
